description:
Outcome: coordinator can establish accurate households, 40 plot records, seasons and prior holdings, from brief.md Background/Rules.
Scope: durable relational schema; coordinator-only roster/contact management; validated private seed/import, exact seasonal dates/timezone/application window, historical holdings, stable household IDs, original timestamps and change history; transactional uniqueness. Excludes: allocation interface, plot map and holder overview.
Acceptance: 40 configured plots; valid March-October seasons; evidence for returning status; one household per plot-season and one plot per household-season enforced; contacts restricted at server boundary.
Behaviour: invalid/duplicate imports rejected atomically with actionable errors; sensitive data absent from logs. User-facing access waits for passwordless role enforcement.
Verification: constraints/import and authorization tests with test principals. Prerequisites: foundation and prototype checkpoint. Assumptions: coordinator supplies accurate roster/history; one sign-in email per household.
title: Household, plot and season records
